tasks.short: Analyze criminal activity patterns and trends

steps.what: Define intelligence comparison and verify source data coverage
Aggregate intelligence data into specified time and location comparisons
Analyze patterns and trends, test explanations and record limitations

tasks.design: Configure {BI} comparisons over a versioned extract in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The analyst retains source validation, definition of comparisons and interpretation; counts are not predictions or grounds for action against individuals.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated aggregation across exports can consume time without resolving data coverage or causation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queries and dashboards can repeat explicit comparisons with source lineage.
tasks.still_hard: Changes in recording or enforcement can resemble changes in criminal activity.
tasks.human_edge: Test alternative explanations and distinguish observed records from underlying prevalence.

ambition.what: Review coverage-qualified aggregate changes between scheduled intelligence reviews

tasks.altitude: Less table preparation may leave more time to challenge apparent trends; investigative powers are unchanged.

reach.task: Translate trend findings into evidence questions
reach.learn: What additional evidence could distinguish competing explanations

evidence.claim: Configured aggregations can reduce repeated table preparation, but the interpretation and saving here are unmeasured model-knowledge assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is pattern analysis, not collection, individual profiling or operational deployment. Source custodians' existing recording remains outside and unchanged.

Analyst produces approved source IDs/versions, event IDs, occurrence versus recording timestamps, category mappings, location precision, inclusion and duplicate rules, coverage intervals, denominators, comparison windows and formulas in s1's retained30 hours, including corrections and any structured entry. Missing fields or incompatible categories require manual reconciliation before aggregation; no clean-data or genuine-trend flag is assumed.
Test native dashboards and queries before custom code. Existing automated tables create zero additional saving. No inferred identity matches are used.
Nine focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover schema/definition drift, samples and exceptions; five other-role hours cover access and pipeline support.
research_questions: Can repeated tables be produced faster after all source validation and coverage checks?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R65 gross35 minus9 upkeep net26. Range0-12 allows incompatible coverage or existing aggregation at0; stable repeat comparisons support modest gains without reducing interpretation.

tasks.short: Prepare intelligence reports and visual presentations

steps.what: Select intelligence findings and verify report sources and presentation requirements
Prepare report shells, presentations, maps and charts from selected fields
Write intelligence interpretation and approve complete reports and presentations

tasks.design: Use native {BI} and {DOCS} templates to render the selected data and standard report structure. The analyst writes the interpretation and approves every complete presentation with its limitations and source references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated chart exports, layout and header copying can be mixed with substantive analytical writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report templates can reuse explicit visual specifications without inventing findings.
tasks.still_hard: Visual choices can imply certainty or relationships the sources do not support.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the findings mean and what the audience must not conclude.
tasks.altitude: Less rendering and layout may leave more time for explanation; release accountability remains human.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of police and detectives
reach.task: Communicate the operational limits of intelligence

evidence.claim: i2 Analyst's Notebook provides link charts and timelines; that supports visual presentation capability, not automated narrative conclusions or this saving estimate.
Template rendering and reduced layout effort are an unmeasured model-knowledge design.

assumptions: Boundary begins with completed analysis, separately counted under21199 or other analysis tasks, and ends with internal approval; no analysis saving is counted again here.

Analyst produces source/version references, selected table values, titles, axes, units, map coordinates and precision, legends, time window, caveats, template and audience in s1's retained30 hours. These are the exact structured inputs for s2; missing geometry or unsupported values require manual preparation, not automatic inference.
Test native export/templates before custom code; already automated chart rendering earns no further saving.
Seven focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover template/source version checks and rendering exceptions; three other-role hours cover configuration support.
unknowns: Visual output versus bespoke narrative share
research_questions: How much repeated rendering remains after native templates and all source checks are counted?

approvals.approved_version: Complete report/presentation text, visual values, source versions, caveats and audience; changes void approval

steps.what: Collaborate with government and intelligence representatives to share information and coordinate activities

tasks.design: Keep substantive coordination and disclosure with the analyst using existing {TELEPHONY} and controlled {DOCS} material. Secure delivery alone does not establish that a disclosure is appropriate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different mandates and source restrictions require agreement and judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing secure communications already support the exchange.
tasks.still_hard: The intended purpose can change during a conversation.
tasks.human_edge: Clarify uncertainty, negotiate responsibilities and limit disclosure to its authorised purpose.
tasks.altitude: Coordination time and disclosure authority remain unchanged.

reach.role: first-line supervisor of police and detectives

evidence.claim: Substantive intelligence coordination remains human; generic integration capability does not establish a shorter coordination conversation.

assumptions: Boundary is focal analyst coordination and information exchange, not partner execution or separate report production. Existing partner meeting time is outside and unchanged.

Analyst verifies recipient, purpose, selected information, source versions and disclosure restrictions within retained100 hours before each related disclosure. Partner questions arise during the conversation before agreements. Missing authority prompts the existing manual escalation; there is no free sharing-permitted flag.
Use native secure channels before custom integration; no automatic onward distribution or extra partner capture is introduced.
Zero incremental upkeep because the process and tools are unchanged.
research_questions: Are partner waiting delays being mistaken for analyst labour?

approvals.approved_version: Exact content, source versions, recipient and purpose for each disclosure; changes require fresh approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; coordination and disclosure checks retain time in routine and disputed exchanges.

steps.what: Verify identities and source-supported links between suspects, organizations and events
Chart verified entities, source references and qualified links
Interpret activities and interrelationships and qualify the chart's limits

tasks.design: Configure the link-analysis application in {OTHER} to draw the analyst's explicit entities and qualified links. The analyst retains identity resolution, relationship interpretation and source checks; proximity on a chart is not evidence of guilt.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual plotting can consume time while leaving entity ambiguity unresolved.
tasks.enabler_now: Native link import and layout can reproduce a verified specification with provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Similar names and indirect associations can produce misleading networks.
tasks.human_edge: Keep reported associations, verified relations and hypotheses distinct.
tasks.altitude: Less plotting may leave more time to test relationship claims; no automated investigative decision is gained.

reach.learn: Which source could confirm or refute a relationship

evidence.claim: i2 Analyst's Notebook provides link charts, timelines and network analysis; this supports charting capability, not automatic identity or criminal relationship decisions.
Plotting savings after human link capture are an unmeasured model-knowledge scenario.

assumptions: OTHER means a link-analysis application. Boundary is link specification, charting and interpretation, not upstream collection or later operational action. Any chart reused in17552 is rendered once in roll-ups.

Analyst produces entity IDs/types, source IDs/versions, exact endpoint pairs, relationship wording, dates, direction and certainty/contestation annotations in s1's retained35 hours, including all structured entry. Unresolved identities remain separate and disputed links remain labelled; missing detail uses manual analysis before rendering. No free matched-identity or criminal-membership flag exists.
Test native import/layout before custom code. Existing automatic layout creates no further saving and does not validate link meaning.
Eight focal upkeep hours per100 baseline cover mappings, provenance samples and exceptions; four other-role hours cover source-access support.
research_questions: Does native plotting save time after complete qualified-link capture and source verification?
